name: webmcp-repo
description: Repo tooling for the webmcp plugin: commit hooks and delegated checks. The publishable package lives in packages/webmcp-bridge.

scripts.lint: npm --prefix packages/webmcp-bridge run lint && npm --prefix packages/webmcp-verify run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/webmcp-bridge run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/webmcp-verify run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/webmcp-bridge test && npm --prefix packages/webmcp-verify test
